correctness.rationale: The total occupancy bound and the monotone range of binomial coefficients give limsup <=1-alpha. With m=floor((1-delta)n^alpha) and L=floor(n/m), a k<=n window meets at most k/L+2 cells, and k/L <= (n^(1-alpha)/L)k^alpha <= (1-delta/2)k^alpha for large n. Above a fixed cutoff the slack absorbs +2; below it there is at most one marker by separation, and windows longer than n have at most m markers. Thus the central-half choices give at least (L/3)^m admissible words; delta down to zero proves the sharp limit at every fixed real alpha. Monotone caps justify zero extension, arbitrary sufficiently long zero connectors give mixing, and k mu[1]<=ceil(k^alpha) forces the zero-point measure. At fine fixed cylinder resolution the orbit counts lie between p(n) and p(n+C), giving D_2=alpha, and the caps give the nested positive-scale systems. Scale zero for the singleton uses the usual zero-dimension convention for bounded counts (equivalently use log log max(e,p(n))); the raw double-log expression for X_alpha is not defined at p=1. Even under the literal unregularized expression the invariant subsystem of configurations with at most one marker has complexity n+1 and realizes zero. The separate exact finite replay tests shortest windows over every choice of cell offsets at four rational parameters, not just sampled words; it is not the all-real proof.
residual_risks: The n-asymptotic is pointwise in alpha; no error uniform towards either endpoint. The scale-zero convention is needed only for bounded counts, not the asserted complexity limit.

value.rationale: The sharp asymptotic quantifies whether local constraints reduce the leading sparse-binomial count. The all-window construction shows that they do not to first order, a finer invariant than ordinary entropy zero. The nested examples also show how a full continuum of diagonal scales can coexist with mixing and a single trivial invariant probability in the ambient shift.
residual_risks: No classification of all invariant subsystems or exact finite-length complexity is asserted.
